Select IC50 activities in nM against target CHEMBL284 (Dipeptidyl peptidase 4). Join molecule_dictionary, activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_structures. Filter by target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', organism = 'Homo sapiens', non-null canonical_smiles, and at least one of pubmed_id or doi. Left join compound_records to obtain compound_key. For pubmed_id_or_doi, prefer pubmed_id when both pubmed_id and doi are present; otherwise use doi. Return distinct rows across compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
